about: Lab services and the CVEs known to affect their exact release, for `python -m dingdongditch.lab_check`. 'affected' lists CVEs the matcher must report as sure matches. 'not_sure' lists CVEs the matcher may report as possible but never as sure, because nothing establishes them for this release. Add an entry for every lab you scan: a Vulhub folder is already a product, a version and a CVE.

not_sure.CVE-2020-1472: Zerologon. NVD lists every Samba before 4.10.18 with no first release, and Samba's advisory is about domain controllers. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-1472

affected.CVE-2011-3192: Range header denial of service, 2.2.x before 2.2.20. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2011-3192
